content: Medium RSS (/feed/@user, /feed/publication) caps at the latest 10 items; member-only posts carry only the public abstract in description (no full body); Medium/CDN-side bot protection can 403 non-browser user agents (same class of Cloudflare-vs-feed-fetcher blocking seen across NewsBlur/home-assistant issues) — a browser-like User-Agent usually unblocks; there is no keyless way to get full paywalled content.
